shots.visual: Extreme close-up of burning fortress gates under the night sky, raging flames reflecting terror.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 他們怎麼可能繞到後方？！

shots.visual: The leader stands on a high cliff overlooking the fire below, wind whipping his dark cloak.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 宛城糧道，今日必斷！

shots.visual: The strategist holds a feather fan, his eyes wide in disbelief at the sudden tactical victory.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公竟能預知天險隘口？

shots.visual: The leader on the left turns sideways to glance at the shocked strategist on the right.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 魏軍的軟肋，我早瞭如指掌。

shots.visual: The leader draws his steel sword, reflecting the flickering firelight with deadly intent.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令下去，半刻鐘內破城！

shots.visual: A massive armored cavalry charges fiercely toward the chaotic city gates.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 蜀軍神兵天降，如入無人之境。

shots.visual: The strategist inspects surrendered army seals placed on a heavy wooden desk.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 宛城守將，竟直接投降了！

shots.visual: The leader sneers slightly, tossing an enemy commander insignia onto the floor.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 兵不血刃，這只是開始。

shots.visual: The strategist on the left bows respectfully to the leader sitting on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公用兵，如天神下凡！

shots.visual: The leader stands up sharply, cold light gleaming in his calculating eyes.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 搜！宛城定有曹丕的密謀。

shots.visual: Heavy iron plates on the tent floor are shattered open by soldiers with axes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 暗室地窖，轟然被撕開。

shots.visual: The leader steps down into a dimly lit underground stone vault, holding a torch.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 藏得夠深，但難逃我眼。

shots.visual: The strategist stoops down to pick up an intricate wooden box bound in red silk.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，這木匣上有魏帝印記！

shots.visual: The leader aggressively breaks the bronze lock off the wooden box with his bare hands.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 給我打開！

shots.visual: The leader on the left pulls out a secret letter while the strategist on the right watches tensely.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕的親筆信件……

shots.visual: The strategist stares at the royal imperial wax seal on the document with horror.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 字跡確實出自洛陽皇宮！

shots.visual: The leader reads the contents of the scroll, veins bulging on his forehead.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 內應？朝中竟有他的狗腿？

shots.visual: The strategist recoils half a step, shocked as he reads the recipient's name.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 這收信人的名字……居然是他？！

shots.visual: The leader crushes the secret letter tightly inside his fist, eyes burning with rage.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 我當他是生死盟友，他卻背叛我！

shots.visual: The strategist on the left raises a hand in warning to the ruthless leader on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，此事萬萬不可洩漏！

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of the leader's murderous eyes, holding the crushed letter to a burning torch flame. Freeze frame.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 下一個要死的，就是你。
